title: Apollo 13 zapped because of a nuclear device

tellings.quote: I found out um that um Apollo 13 may not have failed by a mechanical problem. It may have been zapped by the aliens because they may have had a nuclear warhead on board.

plain: Apollo 13, the 1970 NASA moon mission that had to turn back after an explosion on board, may not have failed from a mechanical fault but been "zapped by the aliens" because it may have carried a nuclear warhead. That is what Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants, says he found out, pointing to the Atomic Energy Commission, the old US agency in charge of nuclear material.
